Register a type for the session

Source: R/register.R
mime_register.Rd

Adds a type under a parent in the hierarchy, so that mime_sniff(), mime_type(), mime_check() and the registry functions know it until the session ends or mime_unregister() removes it. A package that wants its format recognised registers it in its .onLoad().

Usage

mime_register(type, parent, extensions = NULL, rule = NULL)

mime_unregister(type)

Arguments

type

The new type, such as "application/x-myformat".

parent

An existing type the new one descends from.

extensions

File extensions for mime_guess(), without the dot, or NULL.

rule

NULL for a type known by name only; a list of offset (a whole number), bytes (a raw vector or a string, at most 64 bytes) and an optional mask (a raw vector as long as bytes); or a function of one raw vector.

Value

mime_register() returns the type, invisibly. mime_unregister() returns NULL, invisibly.

Details

A data rule, list(offset, bytes, mask), runs in C whenever the bytes have been typed as the parent, costs what a built-in signature costs, and is reported at "definite". A function rule is called from R with the bytes read and must return TRUE or FALSE; it runs last, only when the parent matched, and is reported at "probable". A function rule that raises an error counts as FALSE, and the call warns once with a zumime_rule_warning naming the type. A data rule cannot sit under a type that a function rule decides, since data rules run first.

See also

mime_types(), where registered types show detected_by = "registered".

Examples

mime_register(
  "application/x-zumime-demo",
  "application/octet-stream",
  extensions = "zdemo",
  rule = list(offset = 0, bytes = "ZDEMO")
)
mime_sniff(charToRaw("ZDEMO\x01\x02"))
#> <zumime_result: 1 row>
#>   path                      type confidence charset inner encrypted complete
#> 1 <NA> application/x-zumime-demo   definite    <NA>  <NA>        NA       NA
#>   newline interpreter
#> 1    <NA>        <NA>
mime_guess("file.zdemo")
#> [1] "application/x-zumime-demo"
mime_unregister("application/x-zumime-demo")
